hxstoragelist.h File Reference

Detailed Description

This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit storage list API. A storage list is an extended list implementation, containing list items representing the internal store, as well as SD card and USB drive volumes. This widget is used by the File dialogs as well as the File Manager application.

HxResult HxStorageListDelete ( HxStorageList_t *  pStorageList  ) 

Delete a storage list widget.

HxStorageListDelete deletes a storage list created from an earlier call to HxStorageListNew.

It is not necessary to call this function when quitting the application, since the widget's parent calls this function just before the parent is deleted. HxStorageListDelete only needs to be called when removing a list at runtime.

Parameters:
pStorageList IN: Pointer to the list to delete
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.

HxResult HxStorageListGetDeviceCurrentPath ( HxStorageList_t *  pStorageList,
int32_t  index,
char *  pPath,
int32_t *  pSize 
)

Get the device current path.

HxStorageListGetDeviceCurrentPath returns the path to the mount point of the device. if pPath is null returns minimum buffer size in pSize.

Parameters:
pStorageList IN: Pointer to a storage list
index IN: Index of the device for which to get the path
pPath IN: Buffer for the path string, or NULL
pSize IN/OUT: Pointer to the size of the character buffer. If buffer is too small, the required minimum buffer size is returned
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful. Returns HX_INVALID_ARG if media is not present. Returns HX_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL if pPath is too small to hold the path.
